reasons.text: Certificates claim more than the declared monthly capacity in 70% of months
Uploaded plant photos are near-duplicates of photos registered by 2 other plant(s)
72% of all certificates were generated in a single month
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.81x the cost floor)
Sold products equal only 29% of the output expected from the tonnes claimed
72% of certificate tonnes were generated more than 45 days after the processing month

inspection_checklist: Check installed machinery and shift records against the declared capacity; request production registers for the flagged months.
Compare the plant against the entities sharing its identifiers (bank, address, director, photos); consider a joint inspection.
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
Reconcile product sales with processed tonnes; contact the product buyers listed and verify that they received the material.
